technical: mean of clip(50+25*gap/max(daily sample std20,0.003),0,100) for close/cloudTop-1, MA20/MA60-1, MA60/MA120-1, close/MA20-1, MA60/MA60[t-5]-1
priority: 100 if KR exposure and daily adjusted return exceeds KOSPI by >=2 percentage points, otherwise0; no size/rotation/index-membership bonus
health: (20 if KRX cap>=50bn +10 if cap>=100bn +20 if trailing20 KRX trading value>=1bn +10 plain)/60*100; no hard liquidity gate
environment: stock-only domestic sector; otherwise regional leave-family-out50%continuous trend+50%breadth with >=3 other families, lag1; own-index regime lag1 fallback
entry: Raw Onset t: eligible M0 crosses from <80 to >=80 on consecutive Korean sessions. At t+1 close require eligible M0>=80 and underlying>=MA60; execute t+2 open. Missing/failed confirmation is discarded; a new raw Onset is required. onset field means confirmed actionable entry, not raw crossover.
exit: underlying close<MA60 state; next session open; missing underlying separately labelled data-error exit

sizing.tieBreak: confirmation-day trailing20 KRX trading value descending, symbol ascending for ties

dataPolicy.productionAsOf: latest supplied Korean session; cutoff is research-only
dataPolicy.missing: block new order; do not manufacture zero scores or forward-fill underlying
dataPolicy.calendar: exact consecutive ds.tradeDates sessions; never skip a missing symbol session; trailing20 amounts require matching dates
dataPolicy.signalSuppression: exclude actual/legacy held ETFs and all sales on or after original Onset date; no rewrite of historical executions

researchEvidence.selection: explicit user decision; supersedes proposed power2 choice

limitations: uncertified total return and corporate-action accounting
recent period MDD is not uniformly improved
